description: Delete a specific Company Segment Item.

parameters.name: segment_id
parameters.description: ID of the WBS Segment to scope this request to (e.g., the cost_code or line_item_type segment). On project routes, use a segment in the project's pattern (segments[].id in GET .../projects/{project...

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. The segment item cannot be deleted. The response may include an error_code that identifies the reason.
